service_description: I build custom AI-powered software systems for real estate professionals who need to turn raw property data and market research into client-ready deliverables — fast. Based in Atlanta, GA, my core specialty is a two-flow intelligence pipeline: give me a property and I'll find you the right buyers, or give me a buyer and I'll find you the right properties — complete with prospect lists, marketing materials, and pitch decks generated automatically. My ideal clients are commercial brokers, investment firms, property management companies, and real estate developers who are drowning in data from public records, county databases, and market platforms but lack the systems to extract actionable intelligence from it at scale. A key advantage of my approach is automated property data acquisition — pulling ownership records, tax history, parcel data, and transaction histories from publicly available sources so clients walk into every conversation already armed with market intelligence. I'm a single-member LLC just getting started, which means every client I take on gets my full, undivided attention — you're not handed off to a junior developer, you're working directly with the person who designed and built your system from day one.

I specialize in AI workflow automation for law firms and legal departments in the Boston, MA area. My systems handle document review, contract analysis, case research summarization, and client intake automation. Over the past two years I've built solutions for 15 firms ranging from solo practitioners to mid-size practices, currently generating around $8K monthly in recurring revenue. My differentiator is deep understanding of legal workflows — I spent five years as a paralegal before transitioning to automation consulting, so I know where the real bottlenecks are. I build systems that integrate with existing practice management software like Clio and MyCase while adding intelligent document processing, deadline tracking, and automated client communications.

We're a 6-person AI automation studio based in San Francisco, CA focused on healthcare operations. Our team includes former healthcare administrators, ML engineers, and integration specialists who build HIPAA-compliant automation systems for clinics, specialty practices, and small hospital networks. Our core offerings include patient scheduling optimization, insurance verification automation, clinical documentation assistance, and revenue cycle automation. We've deployed systems across 40+ healthcare facilities throughout the Bay Area and specialize in integrating with major EHR platforms. Our clients typically see 30-40% reduction in administrative overhead within the first quarter.

I design and develop custom websites for independent restaurants, cafes, and food trucks in Austin, TX. Just started my freelance practice after working at an agency for two years. I focus on mobile-first designs with online ordering integration, reservation systems, and menu management that owners can update themselves. My goal is to give local Austin food businesses the same professional web presence as big chains without the enterprise price tag. Currently building my portfolio and offering competitive rates to establish relationships with restaurant owners in the Austin area.

Full-stack developer based in Denver, CO specializing in fitness and wellness industry websites and web applications. I build custom booking systems, membership portals, and e-commerce solutions for gyms, yoga studios, personal trainers, and wellness retreats throughout Colorado. Currently serving 20+ ongoing clients with monthly maintenance contracts generating $7K in recurring revenue. My advantage is deep integration experience with fitness-specific platforms like Mindbody, WellnessLiving, and Trainerize — I can extend what those platforms do or build custom alternatives when clients outgrow them.

Web development agency with 8 team members based in Miami, FL dedicated to the hospitality industry. We build websites, booking engines, and digital guest experience platforms for boutique hotels, vacation rentals, and resort properties throughout South Florida and the Caribbean. Our portfolio includes 100+ hospitality clients across the region. We offer full-service solutions including custom booking systems that compete with OTA commissions, virtual tour integration, dynamic pricing displays, and multi-property management dashboards. Our maintenance and hosting packages ensure clients never worry about uptime during peak booking seasons.

Certified personal trainer launching my independent practice in Chicago, IL after three years at a commercial gym. I specialize in strength training for busy professionals who want results without living at the gym. My approach combines efficient 45-minute sessions with nutrition guidance and accountability check-ins. Currently taking on new clients for early morning and lunch-hour sessions in downtown Chicago and the Loop. I'm building my business on referrals and results — every client gets a customized program and my personal cell number.

Online fitness coach based in Seattle, WA serving remote tech workers dealing with sedentary lifestyle issues. I've built a client base of 60+ active members generating $9K monthly through a combination of 1:1 coaching, small group training via video, and a subscription program with custom workout plans. My niche is specifically addressing posture problems, back pain, and metabolic issues that come from desk work — something Seattle's tech workforce knows all too well. I use a custom app for workout delivery, progress tracking, and async video form checks so clients get expert guidance on their schedule.

Fitness training company with 5 trainers based in Phoenix, AZ specializing in athletic performance for youth athletes and weekend warriors. We operate out of a private training facility in Scottsdale and partner with local sports clubs and high schools across the Valley. Our services include speed and agility training, sport-specific conditioning, injury prevention programs, and team training packages. We're expanding into recovery services with a new sports massage therapist joining the team. Annual revenue approaching $400K with strong growth in our group training programs.

New interior designer based in Nashville, TN focusing on small business spaces — coffee shops, boutique retail, and professional offices under 2000 sq ft. I just completed my certification and am building my portfolio by offering design consultations and space planning for local entrepreneurs who want their physical space to reflect their brand. My background in retail management gives me practical understanding of how spaces need to function for both customers and staff. Looking to establish myself as the go-to designer for Nashville's growing small business community.

Residential interior designer based in Portland, OR specializing in family homes and aging-in-place modifications. I've completed 50+ projects over four years throughout the Portland metro area, currently earning $8K monthly from design fees and trade discounts. My sweet spot is working with families who've outgrown their starter homes and are either renovating or moving up — I help them create spaces that work for their actual lives, not magazine photoshoots. I handle everything from space planning through installation, managing contractors and procurement so clients have one point of contact.

Interior design firm with 4 designers and a project coordinator based in Los Angeles, CA serving the multifamily and commercial real estate development market. We provide design services for apartment amenity spaces, lobby renovations, model units, and tenant improvement buildouts throughout LA County. Our clients are property management companies and developers who need design solutions that balance aesthetics with durability and budget constraints. We've completed projects totaling 200,000+ square feet and specialize in value engineering without sacrificing design impact.

Photographer just starting my business in Dallas, TX focusing on product photography for Etsy sellers and small e-commerce brands. I offer affordable flat-lay and lifestyle product shots that help handmade and small-batch sellers compete with bigger brands. Working from a home studio with professional lighting, I can turn around small product shoots in 48 hours. Building my client base through Texas maker communities and local craft markets throughout the DFW area.

Professional headshot and personal branding photographer based in New York, NY serving entrepreneurs, executives, and professional service providers. I've photographed 500+ clients over three years throughout Manhattan and Brooklyn, generating $7K monthly from session fees and digital licensing. My specialty is making camera-shy professionals look confident and approachable — I work with coaches, consultants, realtors, and attorneys who need photos that build trust before they ever meet a prospect. I offer on-location shoots at client offices or curated outdoor locations around the city.

Photography studio with 3 photographers and a post-production specialist based in San Diego, CA focused on real estate and architectural photography. We serve residential and commercial real estate agents, property developers, and architecture firms across San Diego County. Our services include HDR photography, drone aerial shots, virtual tours, floor plans, and twilight photography. We photograph 50+ properties monthly with same-day delivery options. Our subscription packages give high-volume agents predictable costs and priority scheduling.
